purpose: Separate candidate lithology vocabulary from independently portrayed geological bodies.
decisionLogic: Keep material, composition part, hierarchy role and body morphology distinct
Allow layer-like packages only for compatible domain roles
Treat plutonic candidates as weathering or fracture states, not beds
Do not portray accretionary block or slice constituents as a vertical layer cake
Do not portray metamorphic constituents as invented lithologic zonation
Keep non-geometric constituents as unlocated composition parts
uncertainty: Conservative domain prior; no local contact geometry.
exclusions: Invented lenses, blocks, faults or intrusions
Every candidate as a separate bed
reopenCondition: Route-applicable morphology, orientation or block/lens geometry becomes available
